title: Definitions.
bodyText:
For purposes of this chapter:

"Commission" means the Hawaii state lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, plus commission.

"Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, plus" includes any individual who identifies as a member of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, or queer community, or any individual who identifies as a member of a sexual or gender minority, including intersex, asexual, or pansexual individuals.
bodyHtml:
[§369-2]  Definitions.  For purposes of this chapter:

     "Commission" means the Hawaii state lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, plus commission.

     "Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, plus" includes any individual who identifies as a member of the lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, or queer community, or any individual who identifies as a member of a sexual or gender minority, including intersex, asexual, or pansexual individuals. [L 2022, c 41, pt of §1]
